title: MCP TypeScript client fails with SdkError ERA_NEGOTIATION_FAILED against an older server
symptoms: ERA_NEGOTIATION_FAILED: Version negotiation failed: the server did not offer pinned protocol version 2026-07-28 via server/discover (no fallback in pin mode)
the server gave no modern evidence and this client supports no pre-2026-07-28 protocol version to fall back to
cause: 2026-07-28 drops the initialize handshake and adds server/discover. A v2 client pinned to that version, or one whose supportedProtocolVersions lists only 2026 revisions, has nothing to fall back to when the server still speaks a 2025 revision.
fix: Use versionNegotiation mode auto and keep a 2025 revision in the supported list, so the probe falls back to initialize. Use mode legacy for servers that exit on any request before initialize.
